Shipping Policy

At Naadu Nalam, we aim to make your shopping experience simple and transparent. This Shipping Policy explains how orders are processed, dispatched and delivered.

Last updated: 25/08/2026

On this page

  1. Order processing
  2. Shipping & delivery
  3. Shipping charges
  4. Delivery delays
  5. Incorrect or incomplete address
  6. Damaged, spoiled or incorrect orders
  7. Contact us

1. Order processing

Processing begins once your order has been placed and confirmed on the website. You will see your order details and the total payable, including delivery, before you confirm.

Orders are packed within 24–48 hours on business days (Monday–Saturday). Orders placed on Sunday are packed on the next business day.

Fresh fruits, vegetables and frozen items are bought against the day’s orders. These items are stocked in limited daily quantities and may sell out. Delivery slots for perishable orders may be confirmed by SMS or email.

2. Shipping and delivery

Naadu Nalam delivers across Chennai and select locations in Tamil Nadu, and ships non-perishable items more widely.

  • Chennai and surrounding pin codes — 1–3 business days
  • Other Tamil Nadu metros — 3–5 business days
  • Rest of India — 5–8 business days, non-perishable items only

Fresh fruits, vegetables and frozen items are delivered only within Chennai and selected Tamil Nadu locations. If your pin code is outside our fresh-delivery area, perishable items will not be available at checkout.

Fresh fruits, vegetables and frozen items are packed in insulated packaging and handled on priority.

Receiving your order. Please make sure someone is available to receive the order at the delivery address, particularly for fresh and frozen items. If a delivery cannot be completed because no one is available, we will attempt to contact you to reschedule. Perishable items that cannot be delivered after a failed attempt may not be re-dispatched.

Delivery timelines may vary depending on the delivery location and other circumstances. The estimated delivery information shown during checkout will apply where available.

3. Shipping charges

We charge a flat delivery fee of ₹50 per order, on every order and to every serviceable location. There are no additional handling or packaging charges.

The delivery fee is shown separately in your cart and again on the checkout page before you confirm the order.

4. Delivery delays

The timelines above are estimates, not guarantees. Delivery may be affected by circumstances outside our reasonable control, including:

  • Weather conditions
  • Local restrictions
  • Courier or transport disruption
  • Operational issues
  • An incorrect or incomplete delivery address

If your order is delayed beyond the stated window, contact us using the details below and we will trace it for you.

5. Incorrect or incomplete address

Please check your delivery address, pin code and phone number carefully before confirming an order. An incorrect or incomplete address may delay delivery or prevent it from being completed.

If you notice an error after placing an order, contact us as soon as possible and we will try to update the details before the order is dispatched.

Where a delivery cannot be completed because of an incorrect or incomplete address, we will attempt to contact you to arrange redelivery. As noted above, perishable items that cannot be delivered after a failed attempt may not be re-dispatched.

6. Damaged, spoiled or incorrect orders

If an order arrives damaged, spoiled or incorrect, please report it within 24 hours of delivery.

Please contact us as soon as possible with your order details and relevant photographs where applicable. This helps us resolve the issue quickly and, where needed, raise it with the seller or delivery partner.

Our Refund Policy sets out what is covered and how refunds are processed.

Return & Refund Policy

We want you to have a positive experience with Naadu Nalam. This policy explains when returns, replacements or refunds may be available for eligible orders. Because we sell fresh food and farm products, and many items are perishable, please review this policy before placing an order.

Last updated: 25/08/2026

On this page

  1. Eligibility
  2. Damaged or spoiled products
  3. Incorrect product
  4. Quality concerns
  5. Non-returnable items
  6. Refunds
  7. Replacements
  8. Order cancellation
  9. Contact us

1. Eligibility

The following may be eligible for a refund or replacement:

  • Damaged, spoiled or incorrect items — reported within 24 hours of delivery.
  • Non-perishable products — unopened and in their original packaging, reported within 7 days.

This policy applies to marketplace orders in the same way as to items we supply directly, including items supplied by independent sellers on our marketplace.

2. Damaged or spoiled products

If an item arrives damaged or spoiled, report it within 24 hours of delivery. Please send us:

  • Your order number
  • The product name and details
  • Photographs or a short video of the issue, where applicable
  • A brief description of what is wrong

Photographs help us resolve the issue quickly and, where needed, raise it with the seller or delivery partner.

3. Incorrect product

If you receive a product different from what you ordered, report it within 24 hours of delivery with your order number, the item you received and a photograph where possible.

Where stock allows, we may offer a replacement of the correct item instead of a refund. If a replacement is not available, an approved refund will be processed as set out below.

4. Quality concerns

If you have a genuine concern about the quality or condition of an item you received, tell us within 24 hours of delivery with your order number, photographs where applicable and a description of the problem. We will review each case individually.

Fresh produce is a natural product, so size, colour and appearance will vary from the photographs shown on the website. Natural variation of this kind is not in itself a quality defect.

5. Non-returnable items

The following are not eligible for return:

  • Fresh fruits, vegetables and frozen items, once delivered in acceptable condition.
  • Products that have been consumed, or stored improperly after delivery.

This does not affect your rights where an item was damaged, spoiled or incorrect on delivery and reported within 24 hours.

6. Refunds

Requests are reviewed individually against the eligibility rules above. Once a refund is approved:

  • Orders paid online — the refund is returned to the original payment method within 5–7 business days.
  • Cash on Delivery orders — there is no original payment method to refund to, so we will ask you for a UPI ID or bank account and process the refund there within the same 5–7 business days.

The time taken for the amount to appear in your account after we process it may depend on your bank or payment provider.

7. Replacements

Where stock allows, we may offer a replacement instead of a refund for damaged or incorrect items. We will confirm this with you before arranging it.

8. Order cancellation

If you need to cancel an order, contact us as soon as possible with your order number.

Orders are packed within 24–48 hours on business days, and fresh items are bought against the day’s orders, so cancellation may not be possible once an order has been packed or dispatched.

We may also refuse or cancel an order ourselves for fraud prevention, stock availability or delivery restrictions, as set out in our Terms of Service. Where we do, anything you have already paid for that order is refunded.

Need to report a problem?

Email us with your order number, photos of the issue and a brief description. We typically reply within one business day.

/* ============================================================
   Naadu Nalam - Wishlist page (post 491) presentation layer.
   Styles ShopBuilder's existing .rtsb-wishlist-table output.
   No plugin markup is replaced; presentation only.
   ============================================================ */
body.rtsb-wishlist-page{
  --nnw-green:#18A558;
  --nnw-forest:#14944C;
  --nnw-deep:#0E6B3A;
  --nnw-ink:#071D1F;
  --nnw-muted:#6B7280;
  --nnw-accent:#FF9100;
  --nnw-cream:#F8F6EE;
  --nnw-line:#E7EFE9;
  --nnw-mist:#F6FBF7;
  background:var(--nnw-cream);
}

/* --- soft organic background wash ------------------------- */
body.rtsb-wishlist-page .nn-wl-band,
body.rtsb-wishlist-page .nn-wl-hero,
body.rtsb-wishlist-page .nn-wl-mainwrap,
body.rtsb-wishlist-page .nn-wl-recs{background:transparent !important;}
body.rtsb-wishlist-page .nn-wl-page-bg{
  position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:0;pointer-events:none;
  background:
    radial-gradient(760px 460px at 88% -6%, rgba(24,165,88,.10), transparent 62%),
    radial-gradient(620px 420px at -8% 22%, rgba(255,145,0,.055), transparent 60%),
    radial-gradient(900px 560px at 50% 108%, rgba(20,148,76,.075), transparent 64%),
    var(--nnw-cream);
}
body.rtsb-wishlist-page main{position:relative;z-index:1;}

/* --- breadcrumb band -------------------------------------- */
body.rtsb-wishlist-page .nn-wishlist-breadcrumb{font-size:13.5px;}
body.rtsb-wishlist-page .nn-wishlist-breadcrumb a:hover{color:var(--nnw-forest) !important;}

/* --- hero -------------------------------------------------- */
.nn-wl-hero-in{
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:28px;
  background:linear-gradient(105deg,#FFFFFF 0%,#FFFFFF 46%,#F1F9F3 100%);
  border:1px solid var(--nnw-line);border-radius:22px;
  padding:30px 34px;position:relative;overflow:hidden;
  box-shadow:0 10px 30px rgba(7,29,31,.05);
}
.nn-wl-hero-copy{max-width:640px;position:relative;z-index:2;}
.nn-wl-eyebrow{
  display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;
  font-family:'Outfit',sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.10em;
  text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--nnw-forest);
  background:#EAF7EF;border:1px solid #D2ECDC;border-radius:999px;padding:5px 12px;margin:0 0 12px;
}
.nn-wl-eyebrow svg{width:13px;height:13px;flex:none;}
h1.nn-wl-title{
  font-family:'Fraunces',Georgia,serif;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-.02em;
  font-size:clamp(30px,4.2vw,46px);line-height:1.08;color:var(--nnw-ink);margin:0 0 10px;
}
h1.nn-wl-title em{font-style:normal;color:var(--nnw-green);}
.nn-wl-sub{
  font-family:'Outfit',sans-serif;font-size:16px;line-height:1.6;color:var(--nnw-muted);margin:0;
}
.nn-wl-hero-art{flex:none;width:238px;max-width:38%;opacity:.95;position:relative;z-index:1;}
.nn-wl-hero-art svg{width:100%;height:auto;display:block;}

/* --- main white card -------------------------------------- */
.elementor-element-nn-wl-card-c{
  background:#FFFFFF;border:1px solid var(--nnw-line);border-radius:22px;
  box-shadow:0 14px 38px rgba(7,29,31,.06);
  padding:22px 26px 26px;
}

/* card top row: count + share + clear */
.nn-wl-cardtop{
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:18px;flex-wrap:wrap;
  padding-bottom:16px;border-bottom:1px solid #EEF3EF;
}
.nn-wl-count{
  font-family:'Outfit',sans-serif;font-size:17px;font-weight:600;color:var(--nnw-ink);margin:0;
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;
}
.nn-wl-count svg{width:18px;height:18px;color:var(--nnw-green);flex:none;}
.nn-wl-count b{color:var(--nnw-green);font-weight:700;}
.nn-wl-topright{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;flex-wrap:wrap;}
.nn-wl-share{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;}
.nn-wl-share-label{
  font-family:'Outfit',sans-serif;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;color:var(--nnw-muted);
  margin-right:2px;white-space:nowrap;
}
.nn-wl-share a,.nn-wl-share button{
  width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:50%;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  background:var(--nnw-mist);border:1px solid var(--nnw-line);color:var(--nnw-deep);
  cursor:pointer;padding:0;transition:transform .18s ease,background .18s ease,border-color .18s ease,color .18s ease;
}
.nn-wl-share a:hover,.nn-wl-share button:hover,
.nn-wl-share a:focus-visible,.nn-wl-share button:focus-visible{
  background:var(--nnw-green);border-color:var(--nnw-green);color:#fff;transform:translateY(-2px);
}
.nn-wl-share svg{width:15px;height:15px;fill:currentColor;}
.nn-wl-clear{
  display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;
  font-family:'Outfit',sans-serif;font-size:13.5px;font-weight:600;color:var(--nnw-muted);
  background:transparent;border:1px solid #E3E8E4;border-radius:999px;padding:7px 15px;cursor:pointer;
  transition:color .18s ease,border-color .18s ease,background .18s ease;
}
.nn-wl-clear svg{width:14px;height:14px;}
.nn-wl-clear:hover,.nn-wl-clear:focus-visible{color:#B4452F;border-color:#F0C9BF;background:#FDF4F1;}
.nn-wl-copied{
  font-family:'Outfit',sans-serif;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:600;color:var(--nnw-forest);
  opacity:0;transition:opacity .2s ease;white-space:nowrap;
}
.nn-wl-copied.is-on{opacity:1;}

/* ============ the ShopBuilder table, restyled ============== */
body.rtsb-wishlist-page .rtsb-wishlist-content{overflow:visible;}
body.rtsb-wishlist-page .rtsb-wishlist-table{
  width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;margin:0 !important;border:0 !important;background:transparent !important;
  font-family:'Outfit',sans-serif;
}
body.rtsb-wishlist-page .rtsb-wishlist-table thead th{
  background:transparent !important;border:0 !important;border-bottom:1px solid #EEF3EF !important;
  padding:16px 12px 12px !important;
  font-family:'Outfit',sans-serif !important;font-size:11.5px !important;font-weight:600 !important;
  letter-spacing:.10em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--nnw-muted) !important;text-align:center;
}
body.rtsb-wishlist-page .rtsb-wishlist-table thead th.rtsb-wl-product-info{text-align:left;padding-left:4px !important;}
body.rtsb-wishlist-page .rtsb-wishlist-table thead th.rtsb-wl-product-remove{width:56px;}
body.rtsb-wishlist-page .rtsb-wishlist-table thead th.rtsb-wl-product-remove i{display:none;}
body.rtsb-wishlist-page .rtsb-wishlist-table tbody tr{transition:background .18s ease;}
body.rtsb-wishlist-page .rtsb-wishlist-table tbody tr.rtsb-wl-product:hover{background:#FAFDFB;}
body.rtsb-wishlist-page .rtsb-wishlist-table tbody td{
  background:transparent !important;border:0 !important;border-bottom:1px solid #F1F5F2 !important;
  padding:18px 12px !important;vertical-align:middle;text-align:center;
  font-size:15px !important;color:var(--nnw-ink) !important;
}
body.rtsb-wishlist-page .rtsb-wishlist-table tbody tr:last-child td{border-bottom:0 !important;}
body.rtsb-wishlist-page .rtsb-wl-td-wrapper{display:block;}

/* product cell */
body.rtsb-wishlist-page td.rtsb-wl-product-info{text-align:left !important;padding-left:4px !important;}
body.rtsb-wishlist-page td.rtsb-wl-product-info .rtsb-wl-td-wrapper{
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;text-align:left;
}
body.rtsb-wishlist-page td.rtsb-wl-product-info a.nn-wl-thumb{
  flex:none;width:100px;height:100px;display:block;border-radius:14px;overflow:hidden;
  background:var(--nnw-mist);border:1px solid var(--nnw-line);
}
body.rtsb-wishlist-page td.rtsb-wl-product-info a.nn-wl-thumb img{
  width:100% !important;height:100% !important;object-fit:cover;display:block;margin:0 !important;
  transition:transform .3s ease;
}
body.rtsb-wishlist-page tr.rtsb-wl-product:hover td.rtsb-wl-product-info a.nn-wl-thumb img{transform:scale(1.05);}
body.rtsb-wishlist-page .nn-wl-info{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:5px;min-width:0;}
body.rtsb-wishlist-page .nn-wl-info > a{
  font-family:'Outfit',sans-serif;font-size:16.5px !important;font-weight:600;line-height:1.3;
  color:var(--nnw-ink) !important;text-decoration:none;transition:color .18s ease;
}
body.rtsb-wishlist-page .nn-wl-info > a:hover{color:var(--nnw-forest) !important;}
body.rtsb-wishlist-page .nn-wl-meta{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;flex-wrap:wrap;}
body.rtsb-wishlist-page .nn-wl-badge{
  display:inline-block;font-size:11.5px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.02em;
  color:var(--nnw-deep);background:#EDF7F0;border:1px solid #D9EDE1;border-radius:6px;padding:3px 8px;
}
body.rtsb-wishlist-page .nn-wl-cat{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--nnw-muted);}

/* price cell */
body.rtsb-wishlist-page td.rtsb-wl-product-price .nn-price-stack,
body.rtsb-wishlist-page td.rtsb-wl-product-price .rtsb-wl-td-wrapper{
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:3px;
}
body.rtsb-wishlist-page td.rtsb-wl-product-price .woocommerce-Price-amount{
  font-size:17px;font-weight:700;color:var(--nnw-forest) !important;white-space:nowrap;
}
body.rtsb-wishlist-page td.rtsb-wl-product-price del{opacity:.55;font-weight:400;}
body.rtsb-wishlist-page td.rtsb-wl-product-price del .woocommerce-Price-amount{
  font-size:13.5px;color:var(--nnw-muted) !important;
}
body.rtsb-wishlist-page td.rtsb-wl-product-price ins{text-decoration:none;}
body.rtsb-wishlist-page .nn-pack{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--nnw-muted);font-weight:500;}

/* availability cell */
body.rtsb-wishlist-page td.rtsb-wl-product-availability p.stock{
  margin:0;font-size:13.5px;font-weight:500;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;
  padding:5px 12px;border-radius:999px;
}
body.rtsb-wishlist-page td.rtsb-wl-product-availability p.stock::before{
  content:"";width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;background:currentColor;flex:none;
}
body.rtsb-wishlist-page td.rtsb-wl-product-availability p.stock.in-stock{color:var(--nnw-forest) !important;background:#EDF7F0;}
body.rtsb-wishlist-page td.rtsb-wl-product-availability p.stock.out-of-stock{color:#B4452F !important;background:#FDF1ED;}
body.rtsb-wishlist-page td.rtsb-wl-product-availability p.stock.available-on-backorder{color:#9A6B12 !important;background:#FBF3E2;}

/* action cell */
body.rtsb-wishlist-page td.rtsb-wl-product-add_to_cart .rtsb-wl-td-wrapper{
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:10px;
}
body.rtsb-wishlist-page .nn-qty{
  display:inline-flex;align-items:center;background:var(--nnw-mist);
  border:1px solid var(--nnw-line);border-radius:999px;padding:2px;
}
body.rtsb-wishlist-page .nn-qty button{
  width:28px;height:28px;border-radius:50%;border:0;background:transparent;cursor:pointer;
  color:var(--nnw-deep);font-size:16px;line-height:1;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  transition:background .16s ease,color .16s ease;padding:0;
}
body.rtsb-wishlist-page .nn-qty button:hover:not(:disabled){background:var(--nnw-green);color:#fff;}
body.rtsb-wishlist-page .nn-qty button:disabled{opacity:.35;cursor:not-allowed;}
/* The sitewide input reset forces padding:10px 13px and a 1px border with
   !important onto input[type="number"]. Inside a 34px border-box that left a
   6px content box, so any value wider than one narrow digit was clipped out
   of sight - qty 10 rendered as "1". Win on specificity and give the field a
   content box wide enough for every quantity this stepper can reach. */
body.rtsb-wishlist-page .nn-qty input.nn-qty-in{
  width:40px;box-sizing:content-box;
  padding:0 !important;border:0 !important;border-radius:0 !important;
  background:transparent !important;box-shadow:none !important;
  text-align:center;font-family:'Outfit',sans-serif;
  font-size:15px !important;font-weight:600;line-height:1.2 !important;
  color:var(--nnw-ink);
  -moz-appearance:textfield;appearance:textfield;
}
body.rtsb-wishlist-page .nn-qty input.nn-qty-in:focus-visible{
  outline:2px solid var(--nnw-green);outline-offset:2px;border-radius:8px;
}
body.rtsb-wishlist-page .nn-qty input.nn-qty-in::-webkit-outer-spin-button,
body.rtsb-wishlist-page .nn-qty input.nn-qty-in::-webkit-inner-spin-button{-webkit-appearance:none;margin:0;}
body.rtsb-wishlist-page td.rtsb-wl-product-add_to_cart a.add_to_cart_button,
body.rtsb-wishlist-page td.rtsb-wl-product-add_to_cart a.button{
  display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:7px;
  background:var(--nnw-green) !important;color:#FFFFFF !important;border:1px solid var(--nnw-green) !important;
  border-radius:999px !important;padding:9px 20px !important;min-width:132px;
  font-family:'Outfit',sans-serif;font-size:14px !important;font-weight:600 !important;line-height:1.2 !important;
  text-decoration:none !important;box-shadow:0 4px 12px rgba(24,165,88,.22);
  transition:background .18s ease,box-shadow .18s ease,transform .18s ease;
}
body.rtsb-wishlist-page td.rtsb-wl-product-add_to_cart a.add_to_cart_button:hover,
body.rtsb-wishlist-page td.rtsb-wl-product-add_to_cart a.button:hover{
  background:var(--nnw-forest) !important;border-color:var(--nnw-forest) !important;
  transform:translateY(-1px);box-shadow:0 7px 18px rgba(20,148,76,.28);
}
body.rtsb-wishlist-page td.rtsb-wl-product-add_to_cart a.added_to_cart{
  background:transparent !important;color:var(--nnw-forest) !important;border:1px solid #CFE7D8 !important;
  box-shadow:none;font-size:13px !important;padding:7px 16px !important;min-width:0;
}
body.rtsb-wishlist-page td.rtsb-wl-product-add_to_cart a.added_to_cart:hover{
  background:#EDF7F0 !important;color:var(--nnw-deep) !important;
}

/* remove cell */
body.rtsb-wishlist-page td.rtsb-wl-product-remove a.rtsb-wishlist-remove{
  width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:50%;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  color:#A9B4AC !important;background:transparent;border:1px solid transparent;
  transition:color .18s ease,background .18s ease,border-color .18s ease;
}
body.rtsb-wishlist-page td.rtsb-wl-product-remove a.rtsb-wishlist-remove:hover,
body.rtsb-wishlist-page td.rtsb-wl-product-remove a.rtsb-wishlist-remove:focus-visible{
  color:#B4452F !important;background:#FDF4F1;border-color:#F0C9BF;
}
body.rtsb-wishlist-page td.rtsb-wl-product-remove i{font-size:16px;}

/* plugin's own empty row - replaced by our designed state */
body.rtsb-wishlist-page td.rtsb-wl-empty-text{display:none !important;}
body.rtsb-wishlist-page .elementor-element-nn-wl-table.nn-is-empty{display:none !important;}

/* ---- bottom actions -------------------------------------- */
.nn-wl-actions{
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:flex-end;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;
  padding-top:20px;margin-top:4px;border-top:1px solid #EEF3EF;
}
.nn-wl-actions.nn-is-empty{display:none !important;}
.nn-wl-btn{
  display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;
  font-family:'Outfit',sans-serif;font-size:14.5px;font-weight:600;line-height:1.2;
  border-radius:999px;padding:12px 24px;cursor:pointer;text-decoration:none !important;
  transition:background .18s ease,color .18s ease,border-color .18s ease,transform .18s ease,box-shadow .18s ease;
}
.nn-wl-btn svg{width:16px;height:16px;flex:none;}
.nn-wl-btn--primary{
  background:var(--nnw-green);color:#fff;border:1px solid var(--nnw-green);
  box-shadow:0 6px 16px rgba(24,165,88,.24);
}
.nn-wl-btn--primary:hover,.nn-wl-btn--primary:focus-visible{
  background:var(--nnw-forest);border-color:var(--nnw-forest);color:#fff;
  transform:translateY(-1px);box-shadow:0 9px 22px rgba(20,148,76,.3);
}
.nn-wl-btn--ghost{background:#fff;color:var(--nnw-deep);border:1px solid #CFE7D8;}
.nn-wl-btn--ghost:hover,.nn-wl-btn--ghost:focus-visible{background:#EDF7F0;border-color:var(--nnw-green);color:var(--nnw-deep);}
.nn-wl-btn.is-busy{opacity:.6;pointer-events:none;}

/* ---- empty state ----------------------------------------- */
.nn-wl-empty{display:none;text-align:center;padding:54px 20px 48px;}
.nn-wl-empty.is-on{display:block;}
.nn-wl-empty-art{width:150px;height:auto;margin:0 auto 20px;display:block;}
.nn-wl-empty h2{
  font-family:'Fraunces',Georgia,serif;font-weight:600;font-size:26px;letter-spacing:-.01em;
  color:var(--nnw-ink);margin:0 0 9px;
}
.nn-wl-empty p{
  font-family:'Outfit',sans-serif;font-size:15.5px;line-height:1.6;color:var(--nnw-muted);
  margin:0 auto 22px;max-width:420px;
}

/* ---- recommendations ------------------------------------- */
.nn-wl-rechead{display:flex;align-items:flex-end;justify-content:space-between;gap:18px;flex-wrap:wrap;}
.nn-wl-rechead h2{
  font-family:'Fraunces',Georgia,serif;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-.015em;
  font-size:clamp(22px,2.6vw,30px);line-height:1.15;color:var(--nnw-ink);margin:0 0 5px;
}
.nn-wl-rechead p{font-family:'Outfit',sans-serif;font-size:15px;color:var(--nnw-muted);margin:0;}
.nn-wl-viewall{
  display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;white-space:nowrap;font-family:'Outfit',sans-serif;
  font-size:14.5px;font-weight:600;color:var(--nnw-forest);text-decoration:none;
  border-bottom:1px solid transparent;transition:gap .18s ease,border-color .18s ease;
}
.nn-wl-viewall:hover,.nn-wl-viewall:focus-visible{gap:11px;border-color:var(--nnw-forest);color:var(--nnw-forest);}
.nn-wl-viewall,.nn-wl-btn,.nn-wl-btn:hover,.nn-wl-btn:focus{text-decoration:none !important;}

/* ---- trust strip ----------------------------------------- */
.nn-wl-trust{
  background:linear-gradient(100deg,#EFF8F1 0%,#F3FAF4 55%,#EAF6EE 100%);
  border:1px solid #DCEDE2;border-radius:20px;padding:26px 28px;
  display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:22px;
}
.nn-wl-trust-item{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:13px;}
.nn-wl-trust-ico{
  flex:none;width:42px;height:42px;border-radius:12px;background:#fff;border:1px solid #DCEDE2;
  display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;color:var(--nnw-green);
}
.nn-wl-trust-ico svg{width:20px;height:20px;}
.nn-wl-trust-item h3{
  font-family:'Outfit',sans-serif;font-size:15px;font-weight:600;line-height:1.3;
  color:var(--nnw-ink);margin:0 0 3px;
}
.nn-wl-trust-item p{font-family:'Outfit',sans-serif;font-size:13px;line-height:1.45;color:var(--nnw-muted);margin:0;}

/* ============ tablet ====================================== */

            href += (href.indexOf('?') === -1 ? '?' : '&') + 'quantity=' + n;
          }
          btn.setAttribute('href', href);
        }
      };
      dn.addEventListener('click', function () { input.value = Math.max(1, (parseInt(input.value, 10) || 1) - 1); sync(); });
      up.addEventListener('click', function () { input.value = (parseInt(input.value, 10) || 1) + 1; sync(); });
      input.addEventListener('change', sync);
      input.addEventListener('input', sync);
      sync();
    }
  }

  function esc(s) {
    return String(s).replace(/[&<>"']/g, function (c) {
      return { '&': '&', '<': '<', '>': '>', '"': '"', "'": ''' }[c];
    });
  }

  /* ---------- 3. count + empty state ------------------------ */
  function refresh() {
    var list = rows();
    list.forEach(decorate);
    var n = list.length;

    if (countEl) {
      countEl.innerHTML = n === 1
        ? '<b>1</b> item in your wishlist'
        : '<b>' + n + '</b> items in your wishlist';
    }
    if (tableWrap) { tableWrap.classList.toggle('nn-is-empty', n === 0); }
    if (actionsEl) { actionsEl.classList.toggle('nn-is-empty', n === 0); }
    if (emptyEl) { emptyEl.classList.toggle('is-on', n === 0); }
    if (topEl) { topEl.style.display = n === 0 ? 'none' : ''; }

    buildShare(list);
  }

  /* ---------- 4. share the saved products ------------------- */
  var shareData = { text: '', first: '', media: '' };
  function buildShare(list) {
    var lines = list.map(function (tr) {
      var a = tr.querySelector('.nn-wl-info > a') || tr.querySelector('.rtsb-wl-product-info a[href]');
      if (!a) { return ''; }
      return (a.textContent || '').trim() + ' - ' + a.href;
    }).filter(Boolean);

    shareData.text = lines.length
      ? 'My Naadu Nalam wishlist:\n' + lines.join('\n')
      : '';
    var firstLink = list.length ? list[0].querySelector('.rtsb-wl-product-info a[href]') : null;
    shareData.first = firstLink ? firstLink.href : location.origin + SHOP;
    var firstImg = list.length ? list[0].querySelector('.rtsb-wl-product-info img') : null;
    shareData.media = firstImg ? (firstImg.currentSrc || firstImg.src) : '';

    if (!shareEl) { return; }
    var enc = encodeURIComponent;
    var wa = shareEl.querySelector('[data-share="whatsapp"]');
    var fb = shareEl.querySelector('[data-share="facebook"]');
    var tw = shareEl.querySelector('[data-share="x"]');
    var pi = shareEl.querySelector('[data-share="pinterest"]');
    if (wa) { wa.href = 'https://wa.me/?text=' + enc(shareData.text); }
    if (tw) { tw.href = 'https://twitter.com/intent/tweet?text=' + enc(shareData.text); }
    if (fb) { fb.href = 'https://www.facebook.com/sharer/sharer.php?u=' + enc(shareData.first); }
    if (pi) {
      pi.href = 'https://www.pinterest.com/pin/create/button/?url=' + enc(shareData.first) +
        (shareData.media ? '&media=' + enc(shareData.media) : '') +
        '&description=' + enc('Saved on Naadu Nalam');
    }
  }

  var copyBtn = document.querySelector('[data-share="copy"]');
  if (copyBtn) {
    copyBtn.addEventListener('click', function () {
      var payload = shareData.text || (location.origin + SHOP);
      var done = function () {
        if (!copiedEl) { return; }
        copiedEl.classList.add('is-on');
        setTimeout(function () { copiedEl.classList.remove('is-on'); }, 2200);
      };
      if (navigator.clipboard && navigator.clipboard.writeText) {
        navigator.clipboard.writeText(payload).then(done, function () { fallbackCopy(payload, done); });
      } else {
        fallbackCopy(payload, done);
      }
    });
  }
  function fallbackCopy(text, cb) {
    var ta = document.createElement('textarea');
    ta.value = text;
    ta.setAttribute('readonly', '');
    ta.style.cssText = 'position:absolute;left:-9999px;top:0;';
    document.body.appendChild(ta);
    ta.select();
    try { document.execCommand('copy'); cb(); } catch (e) { /* nothing to do */ }
    document.body.removeChild(ta);
  }

  /* ---------- 5. clear all (uses the plugin's own remove) --- */
  var clearBtn = document.querySelector('[data-nn-wl-clear]');
  if (clearBtn) {
    clearBtn.addEventListener('click', function () {
      var links = rows().map(function (tr) { return tr.querySelector('a.rtsb-wishlist-remove'); }).filter(Boolean);
      if (!links.length) { return; }
      if (!window.confirm('Remove all ' + links.length + ' item' + (links.length === 1 ? '' : 's') + ' from your wishlist?')) { return; }
      clearBtn.classList.add('is-busy');
      /* Each removal rewrites the whole wishlist from its own snapshot, so
         overlapping requests resurrect items. Wait for the plugin to finish
         one removal before starting the next. */
      var $ = window.jQuery;
      var i = 0;
      var timer = null;
      var step = function () {
        clearTimeout(timer);
        if (i >= links.length) {
          clearBtn.classList.remove('is-busy');
          if ($) { $(document).off('rtsb.wishlist.removing_completed', step); }
          setTimeout(refresh, 500);
          return;
        }
        links[i++].click();
        timer = setTimeout(step, 6000);
      };
      if ($) { $(document).on('rtsb.wishlist.removing_completed', step); }
      step();
    });
  }

  /* ---------- 6. add all to cart --------------------------- */
  var addAll = document.querySelector('[data-nn-wl-addall]');
  if (addAll) {
    addAll.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
      e.preventDefault();
      var btns = rows()
        .map(function (tr) { return tr.querySelector('a.add_to_cart_button'); })
        .filter(Boolean);
      if (!btns.length) { return; }
      addAll.classList.add('is-busy');
      var i = 0;
      var timer = null;
      var advance = function () {
        clearTimeout(timer);
        if (i >= btns.length) {
          addAll.classList.remove('is-busy');
          if (window.jQuery) { window.jQuery(document.body).off('added_to_cart', advance); }
          return;
        }
        btns[i++].click();
        timer = setTimeout(advance, 3000);
      };
      if (window.jQuery) { window.jQuery(document.body).on('added_to_cart', advance); }
      advance();
    });
  }

  /* ---------- 7. keep in step with the plugin --------------- */
  var tbody = document.querySelector('.rtsb-wishlist-table tbody');
  if (tbody && window.MutationObserver) {
    new MutationObserver(function () { refresh(); }).observe(tbody, { childList: true, subtree: true });
  }
  if (window.jQuery) {
    window.jQuery(document).on('rtsb.wishlist.removed rtsb.wishlist.added', function () {
      setTimeout(refresh, 700);
    });
  }

  refresh();
})();

Privacy Policy

Your privacy matters to us. This Privacy Policy explains how Naadu Nalam collects, uses, stores and protects information when you use our website and services. It applies to this website and to orders fulfilled through it.

Last updated: 25/08/2026

On this page

  1. Information we collect
  2. How we use your information
  3. Payment information
  4. Cookies
  5. Who we share it with
  6. Keeping your information secure
  7. How long we keep it
  8. Your rights
  9. Children
  10. Grievance redressal
  11. Changes to this policy
  12. Contact us

1. Information we collect

  • Order information — your name, delivery address, pin code, email address and phone number, collected at checkout so we can process, pack, deliver and invoice your order.
  • Account information — if you create an account, your username, email address and saved delivery addresses.
  • Enquiry information — the name, email address and message you submit through our contact form.
  • Technical information — your IP address, browser type and pages viewed, recorded in standard server logs and used to keep the site secure and working correctly.

2. How we use your information

  • To process, pack and deliver your order, and to contact you about it.
  • To handle refunds, replacements and delivery issues under our Refund Policy.
  • To respond to enquiries you send us.
  • To manage your account, where you have created one.
  • To keep records required for tax and accounting purposes.
  • To detect and prevent fraud and misuse of the website.

We send marketing email only if you have asked us to. Every marketing email includes an unsubscribe link, and unsubscribing does not affect order-related messages.

3. Payment information

We do not collect or store your card, UPI or net-banking details.

Where an online payment method is offered, payment is completed on the payment provider’s own secure systems and we receive only a confirmation of the result.

Where you choose Cash on Delivery, payment is collected at the time your order is handed to you.

4. Cookies

We use cookies that are necessary for the site to function, including keeping items in your cart and keeping you signed in.

Most browsers let you block or delete cookies through their settings. Please note that blocking necessary cookies may stop parts of the website, such as the cart and checkout, from working correctly.

5. Who we share it with

We share your information only where it is needed to run the service:

  • Delivery partners — your name, address and phone number, so your order can be delivered.
  • Sellers on our marketplace — where an item is supplied by an independent seller, the details needed to prepare and dispatch that item.
  • Payment providers — where you pay online, to process and verify the transaction.
  • Our hosting and IT providers — who store and process data on our behalf under contract.
  • Authorities — where we are required to disclose information by law.

We do not sell your personal information, and we do not share it for third-party advertising.

6. Keeping your information secure

This website is served over an encrypted HTTPS connection. Access to order and customer data is limited to people who need it to fulfil orders and support customers.

No method of transmission or storage is completely secure, but we take reasonable steps to protect your information against loss, misuse and unauthorised access.

7. How long we keep it

  • Order and invoice records are retained for as long as required under applicable tax and accounting rules.
  • Account details are kept until you ask us to delete your account.
  • Contact-form enquiries are kept only as long as needed to deal with the enquiry.

8. Your rights

Under India’s Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023, you may ask us to:

  • Confirm what personal data we hold about you and obtain a copy of it.
  • Correct data that is inaccurate, incomplete or out of date.
  • Erase your personal data, where we are not required to retain it.
  • Withdraw a consent you previously gave, at any time.
  • Nominate another person to exercise these rights on your behalf.

To make a request, write to us using the contact details below. We will respond within a reasonable period.

9. Children

This website is not directed at children, and we do not knowingly collect personal data from anyone under 18. Orders should be placed by an adult.

10. Grievance redressal

If you have a concern about how your personal data has been handled, contact our grievance officer at hello@naadunalam.in or +91 90921 14630, marking your message for the attention of the Grievance Officer.

If you are not satisfied with our response, you may escalate the matter to the Data Protection Board of India.

11. Changes to this policy

We may update this policy as our services change or as the law requires. The current version is always the one published on this page.
